description: The boundary of Scope::timeout: a race with deadline_ns 100 whose first member's sleep ends exactly at 100, the instant the deadline fires. Rust's tie goes to the deadline: the race reports no winner (winner_index null) and the outcome Cancelled with a Timeout reason, although the member's own sleep ended at 100; the 200 ns member is cancelled but, a Timeout not cutting a sleep short, still sleeps to 200.
